phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Engineering & Design Foundations — Build STEM literacy, explore architectural engineering, and develop design thinking skills.

milestones.label: Explore architectural engineering career pathways
milestones.description: Introduction to engineering disciplines with emphasis on architectural engineering applications in building systems design, structural engineering for buildings, HVAC, lighting, and sustainable building technologies.

milestones.label: Build calculus foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Functions, limits, derivatives, and introduction to integration. Mathematical foundation for structural analysis, building physics, and building systems design.

milestones.label: Master engineering graphics and CAD
milestones.description: Engineering drawing standards, 3D modeling, and computer-aided design (AutoCAD, Revit). Students create architectural and structural drawings for building components.

milestones.label: Join AEI or ASCE student chapter
milestones.description: Join the Architectural Engineering Institute (AEI) student chapter, ASCE, or NSBE. Attend building tours, design competitions, and networking events with structural and building systems engineers.

milestones.label: Study physics foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Mechanics, thermodynamics, and waves. Foundation for structural mechanics, building physics, and HVAC system design.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Building Systems & Structural Foundations — Study structural mechanics, building materials, and MEP systems.

milestones.label: Master statics and mechanics of materials
milestones.description: Force equilibrium, stress/strain analysis, beam deflection, and column buckling for building structural elements. Students analyze real building structural systems.

milestones.label: Study building materials and construction methods
milestones.description: Properties of concrete, steel, wood, masonry, and advanced building materials. Students evaluate material selection for various building applications and sustainability criteria.

milestones.label: Tour construction sites and building systems facilities
milestones.description: Visit active construction sites, mechanical rooms, and building systems installations in the Triad region. Connect classroom concepts to real building engineering practice.

milestones.label: Study building HVAC and mechanical systems
milestones.description: HVAC system design, psychrometrics, heating/cooling load calculations, and indoor air quality. Students design mechanical systems for various building types and climate zones.

milestones.label: Master structural analysis for buildings
milestones.description: Analysis of determinate and indeterminate building structures including frames, trusses, and lateral force resisting systems. Students use structural analysis software for building design.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced Building Design & Professional Experience — Master building structural design, electrical systems, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master steel and concrete building design
milestones.description: Design of steel and reinforced concrete building structural systems using AISC and ACI codes. Students complete structural design for a multi-story building project.

milestones.label: Study building electrical and lighting systems
milestones.description: Electrical power distribution, lighting design, fire alarm systems, and building automation. Students design electrical systems for commercial buildings using NEC codes and lighting analysis software.

milestones.label: Compete in AEI student design competition
milestones.description: Participate in the AEI Student Design Competition, designing integrated building systems (structural, mechanical, electrical) for a real building. Collaborate with multidisciplinary student teams.

milestones.label: Complete summer architectural engineering internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship at a structural engineering firm, MEP consulting firm, or construction company. Apply building systems design skills in professional practice.

milestones.label: Study sustainable building design and energy codes
milestones.description: LEED certification process, energy modeling (eQUEST, EnergyPlus), building envelope design, and net-zero building strategies. Students evaluate building sustainability across climate zones.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone Design & Career Launch — Complete senior design project, prepare for FE exam, and launch engineering career.

milestones.label: Execute senior design capstone project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long integrated building design project including structural, mechanical, electrical, and architectural coordination. Teams design a real building with industry mentor guidance.

milestones.label: Prepare for FE exam and professional licensure
milestones.description: Prepare for the NCEES FE exam through review courses and practice exams. Begin the path toward PE licensure in structural or mechanical engineering.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and AEI chapter leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in architectural engineering coursework, lead AEI or ASCE chapter activities, and organize building tours and industry speaker events.

milestones.label: Develop career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including technical resume, building design portfolio, BIM models, FE exam status, and documented professional network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE Architectural Engineering Exit Assessment demonstrating ABET outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or FE exam results.
